# Opening

The chapter that places both of this book's indexes, and marks a term of its
own so a section carries one locator that is not a recovered chapter's page:
[Aardvark]{.index}.

A second mark of its own, into the book's other index, so neither section is
ever printed empty and each carries a locator from the rendering chapter as
well as recovered ones: [Anvil]{.index index="aside"}.
